name: Jupyter Notebook vs. Spark Job vs. NiFi Dataflow
description: A starter example: walk through a few questions to land on the right tool for a data task.

q-root.text: How large is the dataset you need to process?

choices.text: Small enough to fit in memory on one machine
Too large for a single machine — needs distributed compute

q-scope.text: Is this a one-off exploratory analysis or a repeatable production pipeline?

choices.text: Repeatable pipeline that needs to run on a schedule

q-nature.text: Is the work mostly about moving/transforming data between systems, rather than heavy custom computation?

choices.text: Yes — mostly data movement, routing, or format conversion
No — it involves custom or heavy data transformation logic
